question: How much is one strategy session, and how long does it take?
expected_answer: A Single Strategy Session costs $180 and takes 90 minutes. A written summary follows within 2 business days.

question: I'm on the Growth Package and need to cancel tomorrow morning's session. Will I be charged?
expected_answer: Yes. Less than 48 hours' notice costs 50% of the session fee; a Growth Package session is valued at $158, so the fee is $79. The session can still be rescheduled.

question: After the kickoff session, when do I get the action plan?
expected_answer: Within 5 business days after the kickoff session.

question: Can I just read you my card number over the phone?
expected_answer: No. Card details are never taken over the phone or by email; every invoice has a secure payment link.

question: What happens if I pay an invoice five weeks late?
expected_answer: If an invoice is more than 30 days overdue, new sessions are paused until it is paid; sessions already paid for are not affected. There is no late payment interest.

question: How long do you keep my session notes?
expected_answer: For 2 years after the last session, then they are deleted. You can ask for earlier deletion, which is done within 30 days.

question: Can my business partner join our sessions?
expected_answer: Yes. Up to two other people from your business can join at no extra cost.

question: I'm on the retainer and didn't use my second session this month. Is it lost?
expected_answer: It can be carried over to the next month only. It cannot be carried over a second time and it is not refunded.

question: I asked for information last month but I've decided not to go ahead. Please stop contacting me.
expected_answer: You are removed from the follow-up list on the same day you ask.

question: Can you help me with my tax return?
expected_answer: No. Elena does not provide legal, tax or accounting advice, but she can tell you which questions to ask a specialist.

question: Is there a discount if I pay the retainer a year in advance?
expected_answer: No. Ward Advisory does not offer discounts or special prices.

question: I paid the $950 Growth Package upfront and used 3 sessions. If I cancel now, how much do I get back?
expected_answer: A pro-rata refund for the 3 unused sessions minus the $50 admin fee: 3 × $158 − $50 = $424.

question: If I pay the Growth Package in instalments, how much is each payment, when are the invoices sent and when are they due?
expected_answer: Three payments of $330 ($990 in total): the first invoice at signing, then on the 1st of the next two months. Each invoice is due within 14 days.

question: I started the retainer two months ago. Can I cancel it now?
expected_answer: The retainer has a minimum term of 3 months. After that it can be cancelled with 30 days notice; the current month is not refunded.

question: How long does it take from the discovery call until I have my action plan?
expected_answer: The questionnaire arrives within 24 hours, the kickoff session takes place within 10 days of signing the agreement, and the action plan follows within 5 business days after the kickoff.

question: I was charged twice for my retainer. What happens and when do I see the money?
expected_answer: The extra amount is refunded in full on the same day it is confirmed, with a written refund confirmation. A card refund usually appears within 3 to 7 business days.
key_facts: refunded in full;3 to 7 business days

question: If I email a question on Saturday, when do I hear back, and can we meet in person instead of video?
expected_answer: Retainer clients get a reply within 1 business day, Monday to Friday, so a Saturday email is answered on Monday. In-person meetings are possible for clients in the local area at no extra cost.

question: What is Elena's direct phone number?
expected_answer: The documents do not contain this information.

question: Do you run group workshops for several business owners together?
expected_answer: The documents do not contain this information.

question: How many years of experience does Elena have?
expected_answer: The documents do not contain this information.
